title: Star Wars: A New Hope (Episode IV)
description: The original Star Wars film that introduced Luke Skywalker, Princess Leia, Han Solo, Darth Vader, and the Rebel Alliance's fight against the Galactic Empire.

title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (Episode V)
description: The second film of the original trilogy, following the Rebel Alliance after the destruction of the Death Star and Luke Skywalker's training with Yoda.

title: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (Episode VI)
description: The final film of the original trilogy, depicting the Rebel Alliance's final battle against the Empire and the redemption of Darth Vader.

title: Star Wars: The Phantom Menace (Episode I)
description: The first film of the prequel trilogy, introducing Anakin Skywalker, Qui-Gon Jinn, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and the political crisis surrounding Naboo.

title: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones (Episode II)
description: The second prequel film, showing the beginning of the Clone Wars and the growing relationship between Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala.

title: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (Episode III)
description: The final prequel film, depicting Anakin Skywalker's fall to the dark side and the rise of the Galactic Empire.

title: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
description: An animated theatrical film that launched the Clone Wars animated storyline and introduced Ahsoka Tano as Anakin Skywalker's Padawan.

title: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
description: An animated series exploring the battles, politics, and characters of the Clone Wars era between Attack of the Clones and Revenge of the Sith.

title: Star Wars Rebels
description: An animated series following a small rebel cell as it fights the Empire in the years before A New Hope.

title: Star Wars: The Force Awakens (Episode VII)
description: The first film of the sequel trilogy, introducing Rey, Finn, Poe Dameron, Kylo Ren, and the conflict between the Resistance and the First Order.

title: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
description: A standalone film about the Rebel mission to steal the Death Star plans shortly before the events of A New Hope.

title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi (Episode VIII)
description: The second film of the sequel trilogy, focusing on Rey's training with Luke Skywalker and the Resistance's struggle against the First Order.

title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
description: A standalone film exploring the early adventures of Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Lando Calrissian.

title: Star Wars Resistance
description: An animated series set before and during the sequel trilogy, following pilot Kazuda Xiono and the growing threat of the First Order.

title: The Mandalorian
description: A live-action series following Din Djarin, a Mandalorian bounty hunter, and Grogu in the years after the fall of the Empire.

title: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Episode IX)
description: The final film of the sequel trilogy, concluding the Skywalker saga and the conflict between the Resistance and the Final Order.

title: Star Wars: The Bad Batch
description: An animated series following Clone Force 99 in the aftermath of the Clone Wars and the rise of the Empire.

title: The Book of Boba Fett
description: A live-action series centered on Boba Fett and Fennec Shand as they attempt to control Jabba the Hutt's former territory.

title: Obi-Wan Kenobi
description: A live-action limited series following Obi-Wan Kenobi during his exile between Revenge of the Sith and A New Hope.

title: Andor
description: A live-action series following Cassian Andor and the early formation of the Rebel Alliance.

title: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi
description: An animated anthology series exploring key moments in the lives of Jedi characters such as Ahsoka Tano and Count Dooku.

title: Ahsoka
description: A live-action series following Ahsoka Tano as she investigates a new threat connected to Grand Admiral Thrawn.

title: Star Wars: Tales of the Empire
description: An animated anthology series focused on characters connected to the Galactic Empire and the dark side.

title: The Acolyte
description: A live-action series set during the High Republic era, exploring dark side mysteries before the events of the Skywalker saga.

title: Skeleton Crew
description: A live-action series following a group of children lost in the galaxy during the New Republic era.

title: Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
description: An animated anthology project focused on underworld figures and criminal elements in the Star Wars galaxy.

title: Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
description: An animated Star Wars project centered on Maul and his influence in the criminal underworld.

title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
description: A theatrical Star Wars film continuing the story of Din Djarin and Grogu after the events of The Mandalorian.

title: Star Wars: Starfighter
description: An upcoming theatrical Star Wars film planned for release after The Mandalorian and Grogu.
